nom: TONYMOLY Tako Pore Blackhead Scrub Stick

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report good tolerance — no irritation and no breakouts, including one who says she is otherwise unable to use facial scrubs at all — though how well it actually clears blackheads varies.
segments.dry: Reviewers who describe their skin as dry or normal-to-dry report no adverse reaction, with blackheads and whiteheads clearing and their skin left smooth.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin who deals with near-constant blackheads on her nose reports her pores came out completely clear.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, acne-prone skin reports the scrub never leaves her skin red or irritated, even though she is otherwise unable to use facial scrubs.
segments.normal: One reviewer who describes her skin as normally clear and rarely prone to breakouts reports a severe breakout across her nose and face after using this product, the only change in her routine.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report the scrub reduces or clears blackheads and whiteheads, in some cases after a single use, and several say it succeeded where other treatments — pore strips, charcoal masks, facials — had failed; a substantial minority, however, report the opposite: worse or more clogged pores, new pimples or rashes across the nose, or no visible difference at all after weeks of regular use.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers report the scrub left their nose red and irritated; by contrast, at least one reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin reports her skin is never red or irritated after use.
concerns.dehydration: A few reviewers note the scrub can leave skin dry or flaky the day after, especially with frequent use, and two describe a severe reaction of peeling or burning skin; several others, however, report their skin feels hydrated, soft, and not dry afterward, especially when followed by a moisturizer.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers describe the product leaving a greasy film or residue on the skin after use that needs to be washed away.

aspects.libelle: Leaves skin feeling smooth and soft

extraits.texte: Horrible! This thing made me breakout all over my nose and face. Only thing that was different in my face wash routine. My nose hurts so bad from the breakout! I always had "nice" skin and rarely breakout but this made me breakout so bad!
I must have had a reaction to it or something. My skin is still peeling and burns where I used it.

I bought this in the Ulta store because of the super cute packaging and the promise of getting rid of my blackheads. I have oily skin and almost constant blackheads on my nose. Used this little guy in the shower after cleansing and my pores are completely clear. I wear a lot of makeup on a daily basis so this is a dream.

I have combination, acne-prone, sensitive skin that is prone to hyperpigmentation and deep, long-lasting pimples. I'm very fair and in my early thirties. This product is fantastic! While I have all the Tako products and love them, this was my first purchase due to the price point. I wish this was a full-sized cleanser, because that is what I use it for. I don't use it every day, unless I am focusing on a target area. The sea salt and marine extracts are remarkably soothing on problem skin. My skin is never red or irritated after using this, and I am unable to use facial scrubs. My skin is velvety and perfectly moisturized after rinsing this off, and the smell is lovely. This also does not taste bad like the Tako cleansing stick, if you are using it around your lips. Please keep carrying this, as I can never be without it!

This is the first product that has ever worked on the obnoxious little whiteheads and blackheads I get around my lip line. After consistent (almost) daily use they all cleared up and no more have formed. I have dry, slightly sensitive skin and I haven't had any adverse effects
It felt scruby, but left a residue even after washing off and caused me to get clogged pores worse than before use.

I was presently surprised how well this worked out for me. I have normal to dry skin. I have really stubborn white heads on my forehead and nose. This made my bumps on the forehead so smooth, from just one use. The bumps almost all went away by morning! It's amazing. The scrub is a bit harsh but I think it needs to. I have sensitive skin & this did not irritate it. The whiteheads on my nose smoothed out and there are no visable holes on my nose like most nose strips can do. Love so much! I bought many backups already. U need to use as directed though. 3-4x a week. Too bad it's small but it's mighty. I'm happy to final found something that helps rid my whiteheads.
